Don.name: Don
Don.data: Entertainment mogul, CEO of DON-ISM Agency
Don.description: Former pro wrestler turned entertainment magnate. 6'4", 330 lbs. Produces high-impact theatrical events. Executive producer of "Doomsday Deathmatch."

Yumi.name: Yumi
Yumi.description: A-list actress and JoyPolis executive. Known for her sharp business acumen and sharp tongue. Had a severe phobia of the color red.

badge.name: Attorney's Badge
badge.data: My most precious possession. Can't practice law without it.

Vase.name: Vase
Vase.description: A shattered glass vase. Believed to be the murder weapon. Made of thick glass, yet utterly destroyed.

Belt.name: Belt
Belt.description: The victim's harness. "Yumi" is written on the back. For some reason, blue and red paint stains are on it.

Fence.name: Chain-Link Fence
Fence.description: The fence post is 16 feet high. The sharp spikes make climbing impossible.

GlassShard.name: Glass Fragment
GlassShard.description: A shard of glass hidden behind debris. Thin glass with paint coating. Inside shows what looks like red blood residue. Has a drawing on the outside.

MissingCostume.name: Missing Costume
MissingCostume.description: One of the victim's stage costumes is unaccounted for. Should be hanging on the rack, but it's gone.

FakeBlood.name: Stage Blood
FakeBlood.description: Fake blood prop not scheduled for use in the show. The victim had a severe phobia of the color red.

GlowingFragment.name: Glowing Fragment
GlowingFragment.description: Thin glass fragment coated with luminescent paint. Red residue that looks like paint is on the back.
